title: The chain's draft copy splits a heavy shared unit by default; the staff switch wholeShared keeps it whole
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The chain's draft copy starts with --split-shared unless the build started with wholeShared on; wholeShared adds no flag of its own.

tests: a switch adds its flag only to its own step
a build keeps the switches read at its first step: turned on after its plan started, its draft copy still splits
